papers.title: Roads not taken: The mismatch between safety and regulation of plant breeding innovation
papers.abstract: Meeting global food security goals while reducing agriculture’s environmental impact requires continued crop improvement and innovation. Advances in transgenesis, cisgenesis, and genome editing now enable increasingly precise genetic modification with risks comparable to those of conventional breeding, yet regulatory frameworks remain focused on the method used rather than the product. We highlight recent examples, including immune receptor transfer, cisgenesis-based disease resistance stacking, photosynthesis engineering, and AI-guided protein design, that illustrate innovations constrained by current regulatory approaches. A decisive shift toward science-based, proportionate, and product-focused regulation is needed so that improved crops are evaluated on the basis of their properties, not how they were made.
papers.titleZh: 育種創新受限：安全與法規的落差
papers.summaryZh: 本文指出，為達成全球糧食安全目標並降低農業環境衝擊，需要持續的作物改良與創新。作者說明轉基因、順基因與基因編輯等技術已能進行更精確的遺傳改良，其風險可比擬傳統育種，但現行法規框架仍聚焦於使用的方法而非產品本身。文中舉出免疫受體轉移、順基因為基礎的抗病性堆疊、光合作用工程，以及 AI 導向蛋白設計等近期案例，說明現行法規如何限制這些創新。作者主張應轉向以科學為基礎、相稱且以產品為核心的管制，使改良作物依其特性而非製備方式被評估。

papers.title: Calorie restriction uncouples mutation rate from lifespan
papers.abstract: In this issue of Cell, Grońska-Pęski et al. examine how calorie restriction (CR) affects DNA mutation rates. While CR lowers the accumulation of mutations, this effect does not scale with the degree of lifespan extension. Their work raises important new questions about how CR impacts the causal mechanisms of aging.
papers.titleZh: 熱量限制使突變率與壽命脫鉤
papers.summaryZh: Cell 期刊刊載 Grońska-Pęski 等人的研究，探討熱量限制 Calorie restriction 對 DNA 突變率的影響。研究發現熱量限制會降低突變的累積，但此效應並未隨壽命延長的程度而等比例變化。該結果顯示突變率的下降與壽命延長之間並非簡單的線性關聯。作者指出此發現為熱量限制如何影響老化的因果機制提出了新的問題。

papers.title: Guardians at the gate: cMAF keeps the brain’s vasculature in check
papers.abstract: In this issue of Cell, Brioschi et al. identify cellular musculoaponeurotic fibrosarcoma (cMAF) as a key regulator of brain perivascular macrophages that supports cerebrovascular function through insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) production. This cMAF-IGF1 program is enhanced in Alzheimer’s disease (AD), potentially reflecting a protective response that is lost in APOE4 carriers.
papers.titleZh: cMAF 調控腦血管周圍巨噬細胞維持血管功能
papers.summaryZh: Cell 期刊刊載 Brioschi 等人的研究，指出細胞型肌肉瘤相關因子 cMAF 是腦部血管周圍巨噬細胞的關鍵調控因子。該研究發現 cMAF 透過促進胰島素樣生長因子 1 IGF1 的產生來支持腦血管功能。研究亦觀察到此 cMAF-IGF1 程序在阿茲海默症 AD 中增強，可能反映一種保護性反應。研究指出此保護性反應在 APOE4 帶因者中可能喪失。

papers.title: Toward planetary microbial systems biology
papers.abstract: Planetary microbial systems biology, encompassing multi-omics, AI, and field-to-lab interaction, is proposed as a framework to study Earth’s interconnected microbiomes at a planetary scale.
papers.titleZh: 邁向行星微生物系統生物學
papers.summaryZh: 本文提出行星微生物系統生物學作為一個研究框架。該框架旨在以行星尺度探討地球上相互連結的微生物群。所提出的範疇包含多體學、人工智慧以及田野與實驗室的互動。作者主張此框架可作為整合性方法來研究地球微生物系統。

papers.title: Methylated eEF1A selectively decodes mRNA to shape cancer proteomes
papers.abstract: The authors show that METTL13-mediated eEF1A K55 dimethylation enhances decoding of rare codons, boosting translation of oncogenic proteins including KRAS and promoting KRAS-inhibitor resistance in lung cancer.
papers.titleZh: 甲基化 eEF1A 選擇性解碼 mRNA 塑造癌症蛋白體
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出 METTL13 介導的 eEF1A K55 二甲基化會增強稀有密碼子的解碼效率。該修飾提升了包含 KRAS 在內的致癌蛋白的翻譯。作者觀察到此機制與肺癌中 KRAS 抑制劑抗藥性的促進相關。結果顯示甲基化 eEF1A 可選擇性影響 mRNA 解碼並形塑癌症蛋白體。

papers.title: Autophagy in macrophages curtails IL-1α-mediated immune priming against lung infections
papers.abstract: Wang and colleagues show that autophagy deficiency in alveolar macrophages upregulates the expression of IL-1α and increases resistance to respiratory infections.
papers.titleZh: 巨噬細胞自噬限制肺部感染的 IL-1α 免疫致敏
papers.summaryZh: Wang 等人研究指出，肺泡巨噬細胞中自噬功能缺失會上調 IL-1α 的表現。該結果與呼吸道感染的抵抗力增加相關。研究聚焦於自噬在巨噬細胞中對 IL-1α 介導的免疫致敏的調控作用。

papers.title: Informed, scalable and unified transport couplings for single-cell alignment and downstream inference with scBIOT
papers.abstract: Single-cell genomics requires methods that account for technical variation while preserving biological signals, remain tractable at atlas scale and support analyses beyond visualization, but existing approaches discard the fitted correspondence that could connect these tasks. Here we introduce scBIOT, a biologically informed optimal-transport framework that formulates single-cell alignment as an explicit and inspectable coupling between cells. scBIOT incorporates prior biological knowledge to preserve known cell identities, compresses transport through prototypes for large datasets and quantifies gene-level changes induced by alignment using coupling-derived transport scores. Across transcriptomic and spatial mapping benchmarks, scBIOT balanced biological conservation, batch correction and label-transfer accuracy while distinguishing batch-associated stress responses from biological immune and drug-response programs. Prototype transport scaled coupling-based analysis to approximately 100 million perturbed cells. Because the coupling encodes probabilistic correspondences rather than only corrected coordinates, the same fitted coupling supports state mapping, trajectory inference, perturbation analysis, multimodal comparison and spatiotemporal localization. Applications to cancer, hematopoiesis and embryonic development identified condition-specific cell states, modality-dependent regulatory programs and spatially resolved developmental transitions. Informed, scalable and unified transport couplings therefore link atlas alignment to downstream biological inference within a single framework.
papers.titleZh: 以生物資訊引導的單細胞對齊與下游推論框架 scBIOT
papers.summaryZh: 研究提出 scBIOT，一個以生物資訊為基礎的最適傳輸框架，將單細胞對齊表述為細胞間明確且可檢視的耦合。scBIOT 透過納入先驗生物知識保留已知細胞身份，並以原型壓縮傳輸以處理大型資料集，同時利用耦合衍生的傳輸分數量化對齊誘發的基因層級變化。在轉錄組與空間映射基準測試中，scBIOT 在生物保守性、批次校正與標籤轉移準確度之間取得平衡，並能區分批次相關的壓力反應與生物性的免疫與藥物反應程序。原型傳輸使耦合為基礎的分析擴展至約一億個擾動細胞，且同一擬合耦合可支援狀態映射、軌跡推論、擾動分析、多模態比較與時空定位。應用於癌症、造血與胚胎發育時，辨識出條件特異性細胞狀態、模態依賴性調控程序與空間解析的發育轉換。

papers.title: Spatialsnake: a flexible workflow for spatial transcriptomics analysis across platforms
papers.abstract: Background: Spatial transcriptomics technologies measure gene expression at different spatial resolutions and generate diverse data outputs. Existing workflows support a range of platforms and analyses, but combining methods and extending analyses to selected populations or tissue regions can require additional scripts and repeated data preparation. Findings: We developed Spatialsnake, a flexible workflow built on SpatialData and Snakemake for analysing processed outputs from Visium, Visium HD, Stereo-seq, Xenium and MERFISH. A common command-line interface supports single- and multi-sample analysis, with adjustable parameters and saved intermediate results. Users can select populations, tissue regions or distance-based neighborhoods, repeat clustering and annotation, and map refined labels back to the full dataset. Additional modules support cell-type composition estimation, spatial-domain identification, cell-cell communication inference, regulon analysis and sample-level comparisons. We demonstrate these functions using mouse-brain Visium and colorectal cancer Visium HD datasets. Joint analysis of three colorectal cancer sections retained 1,527,987 bins and enabled further analysis of 223,632 epithelial bins, linking epithelial subpopulation annotations to their locations within the complete tissue. Conclusions: Spatialsnake provides a unified workflow for spatial transcriptomics analysis across sequencing- and imaging-based platforms. Its flexible analysis modules support both whole-tissue analysis and further investigation of selected cell populations and tissue regions.
papers.titleZh: Spatialsnake：跨平台空間轉錄組學分析的彈性工作流程

papers.title: Evaluation of Cross-slice Imputation for Spatial Proteomics
papers.abstract: Spatial single-cell protein profiling is at the forefront of translational medicine research efforts that try to decipher tissue heterogeneity. However, existing experimental approaches are limited in the number of biomarkers that they measure. This has motivated extensive research into the problem of protein imputation, where proteins or biomarkers not directly measured in a given slice of biopsy tissue are learned from those measured. In this work, we focus on the specific problem of cross-slice protein imputation (CSPI). In the CSPI problem, two sets of biomarker expressions at the single-cell level are known for physically adjacent slices of tissue. Each slice has its own known set of biomarkers, which overlaps with but does not subsume that of the adjacent. For each slice, we wish to learn the expressions of the proteins unique to the adjacent. Existing literature for protein imputation methodologies can be grouped in two categories: learning-based and alignment-based approaches. Learning-based approaches do not account for spatial and structural similarities between the training and the target sets. Alignment based approaches aim to determine an association between cells in adjacent slices, but without the explicit goal of using this alignment for imputation. In this work, we evaluate several methods from both categories and their adaptability to the cross-slice protein imputation problem. We provide a statistical analysis of all methods' performance under varying conditions of implementation. We find that learning-based methods significantly outperform alignment-based methods at the task of cross-slice protein imputation, with the latter more suited to the task of inter-slice interpolation or 3D tissue reconstruction. Moreover, inter-patient imputation is far less accurate than intra-patient imputation for all methods evaluated.
papers.titleZh: 評估跨切片蛋白質推估於空間蛋白體學
papers.summaryZh: 本研究聚焦於空間單細胞蛋白質分析中跨切片蛋白質推估 Cross-slice Protein Imputation, CSPI 的問題。CSPI 的設定為兩片物理上相鄰的組織切片在單細胞層級已知不同且部分重疊的生物標記表現，目標是學習每片切片中獨屬於鄰片的蛋白質表現。作者比較了現有蛋白質推估文獻中的學習型與對齊型兩類方法，並評估其對 CSPI 問題的適用性。統計分析顯示，學習型方法在跨切片蛋白質推估任務上顯著優於對齊型方法，而對齊型方法更適合切片間插值或三維組織重建。此外，所有評估方法中，跨病人推估的準確度遠低於同病人內推估。

papers.title: Scooby-2: fine-tuning AlphaGenome for single-cell genomic track prediction
papers.abstract: Sequence-to-function models predict genomic tracks from DNA sequence. AlphaGenome has been shown to outperform previous models, including Borzoi, on most track-prediction and variant-effect benchmarks. However, like its predecessors, it predicts tracks only for predefined, mostly bulk-derived cell types and tissues. While Scooby has extended Borzoi to single-cell resolution, a single-cell adaptation of AlphaGenome is still lacking. We present Scooby-2, which combines AlphaGenome with a cell-specific decoder to predict single-cell RNA-seq coverage and chromatin-accessibility genomic tracks from DNA sequence. The package provides the implementation, the parameter-efficient fine-tuning setup, the training pipeline and inference scripts. When evaluated on the NeurIPS bone marrow single-cell dataset, Scooby-2 achieved a Pearson correlation of 0.56 when predicting cell-type-specific gene expression differences, compared with 0.53 for Scooby. When using the distilled AlphaGenome backbone, variant effect prediction concordance of fine-mapped eQTLs from the OneK1K cohort improved from 0.37 to 0.47 Spearman's rank correlation across all associations, an improvement consistent with that of AlphaGenome over Borzoi itself.
papers.titleZh: Scooby-2：微調 AlphaGenome 以進行單細胞基因組軌跡預測

papers.title: Joint localization and testing reveals spatial context of differential expression
papers.abstract: Multi-subject spatial transcriptomics is increasingly used to identify molecular differences across individuals and conditions while resolving where in tissue those differences occur. Yet subject-level differential expression (DE) analyses commonly require spatial regions to be specified in advance, separating localization from testing. Here we present SpaceDX, a framework that uses gene-specific attention-based spatial weighting to jointly test differential expression and localize the spatial expression patterns contributing to these associations. In simulations, SpaceDX outperforms cluster-based DE methods when differential expression does not align with predefined spatial boundaries. Across two multi-subject mouse brain datasets, SpaceDX detected 45.8% more DE genes than regional DESeq2 pseudobulk in a chronic stress model, while in an Alzheimer's disease model combining SpaceDX with DESeq2 increased discovery by 19.1% relative to DESeq2 alone. Across both datasets, the learned maps provided spatial context for condition-associated expression signals in addition to gene-level significance. In the chronic stress model, for example, oligodendrocyte- and myelin-associated genes showed shared localization to corresponding brain structures. Together, these results show that the spatial context of differential expression can be inferred jointly with gene-level associations, recovering signals obscured by regional aggregation without requiring the relevant tissue context to be defined in advance.
papers.titleZh: 聯合定位與檢定揭示差異表現的空間脈絡

papers.title: Tree shrew more closely recapitulates primate spermatogenesis than the mouse in cross-species single-cell transcriptomic analyses
papers.abstract: By comparing testis cell development across four mammals, this study shows that tree shrews more closely resemble primates than mice in key stages of sperm formation, supporting their use as a complementary model of human male fertility.
papers.titleZh: 樹鼩精子生成更接近靈長類
papers.summaryZh: 本研究透過跨物種單細胞轉錄體分析比較四種哺乳動物的睪丸細胞發育。結果顯示，在精子形成的關鍵階段，樹鼩與靈長類的相似度高於小鼠。研究指出樹鼩在重現靈長類精子生成方面比小鼠更接近。這一發現支持將樹鼩作為人類男性生育力研究的補充模式。

papers.title: Global arable land redistribution toward the tropics and drylands under human settlement expansion
papers.abstract: Arable land is changing through urban encroachment, forest conversion and dryland expansion, but these shifts are often viewed separately. The study demonstrates a unifying framework for global arable land redistribution and its environmental consequences.
papers.titleZh: 人類聚落擴張下可耕地向熱帶與乾旱區重新分配
papers.summaryZh: 研究指出可耕地正因都市侵占、森林轉換與乾旱區擴張而改變，但這些變化常被分開看待。該研究提出一個統一框架來描述全球可耕地的重新分配及其環境後果。論文標題顯示此重新分配呈現朝向熱帶與乾旱區的趨勢，並與人類聚落擴張相關。透過整合性的觀點，研究試圖將原本分散的土地變化連結起來。

papers.title: Darutigenol ameliorates experimental colitis via promoting Akkermansia muciniphila-mediated proline synthesis
papers.abstract: Here, the authors show that Darutigenol inhibits host IDO1 expression to drive A. muciniphila expansion and proline synthesis, thereby alleviating inflammation and presenting a potential strategy for IBD treatment.
papers.titleZh: Darutigenol 促進 Akkermansia muciniphila 介導的脯胺酸合成改善實驗性結腸炎
papers.summaryZh: 本研究報導 Darutigenol 可改善實驗性結腸炎，其作用途徑與促進 Akkermansia muciniphila 介導的脯胺酸合成有關。作者指出 Darutigenol 會抑制宿主 IDO1 表現，從而驅動 A. muciniphila 擴增與脯胺酸合成。該作用與緩解發炎相關。研究提出此機制可能為發炎性腸道疾病治療提供潛在策略。

papers.title: Aberrant thymic architecture and enhanced interferon signaling in Down syndrome
papers.abstract: Down syndrome is a complex condition which results in immune alterations, including higher risk of autoimmune diseases. Here the authors show by single cell and spatial transcriptomics that the differentiation of thymic T cell precursors is disturbed in Down syndrome, which might underpin the functional alterations.
papers.titleZh: 唐氏症出現異常胸腺結構與干擾素訊號增強
papers.summaryZh: 本研究探討唐氏症的免疫改變。唐氏症為複雜疾病，會導致免疫異常，並伴隨自體免疫疾病風險升高。作者以單細胞與空間轉錄體學分析發現，唐氏症中胸腺 T 細胞前驅細胞的分化受干擾。論文標題指出研究觀察到異常的胸腺結構與增強的干擾素訊號。此發現可能有助於解釋唐氏症相關的功能性免疫改變。

Framework desymmetrization enables partial pore space partition in metal-organic frameworks
paper.abstract: Framework desymmetrization enables partial pore-space partition in acs nets, yielding part-pacs as a new pore partition mechanism. Retained open metal sites boost C₂H₂/CO₂ selectivity and productivity.

paper.title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
paper.abstract: Magnons in quantum Hall ferromagnets can be used as a very sensitive probe of magnetic order. Thus far, this technique has only been applied to single material systems. Here, Lee et al extend this to a heterostructure, using magnons generated in a monolayer of graphene to detect spin order in bilayer graphene.

paper.title: A training-free, domain-extensible LLM-based approach for automated extraction of standardized preparation procedures
paper.abstract: A domain-agnostic, training-free workflow leverages open-source large language models with explicit action sets and post-processing rules to extract laboratory procedures from unstructured text, demonstrated through zeolite synthesis.
